name: Siegfried Mureşan - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: Draft amending budget 2/2024: surplus of the financial year 2023
part_text:
The European Union ended 2023 with money left over: 633 million euro. This report agrees to put that leftover money into the 2024 budget. That lowers what member states pay in. Parliament welcomes the smaller surplus than last year and says the budget still needs enough room to react to surprises. It also repeats its view that fines should count as extra income for the Union, not reduce countries' contributions.

- **What changes:** 633 million euro of leftover 2023 money goes into the 2024 budget.
- **Who it affects:** Member states pay less into the 2024 budget; five countries keep their rebates.
- **What happens next:** Parliament approves the plan, so the amended budget is adopted and published.
